summary: Feed s095_single to SIEM is degraded due to 19.3% duplicate packets (611/3161). All other visibility checks healthy: no one-way traffic, no packet drops, no tool overload, VLANs 10,20 present, and encrypted share within tolerance.

findings.root_cause: Packet broker is aggregating the same traffic from two sources (e.g., dual SPANs or both sides of a TAP pair) without deduplication, so identical packets are forwarded twice to the SIEM feed.
findings.impact_on_tool: SIEM wastes EPS/license and storage on 19% duplicate events, inflates correlation counts and can cause false positives or missed detections due to noisy event volume; no payload or directionality impact as SIEM does not require both directions or full payload.

recommended_fix.why: Enable packet-broker deduplication on s095_single to drop identical packets within a short time window before delivery, restoring correct event counts and freeing SIEM capacity without losing coverage.
